text:
Devon (Sales): Quick handoff for Novus Health -> CS. SOW signed for Private (VPC) deployment; target go-live 2024-05-10. Primary contact: Raj Patel (raj@novushealth.com). Must-haves: Okta SSO, HIPAA controls, burst capacity ~500 concurrent requests during triage windows. Pilot is 12 months; likely Dedicated expansion in Q3 if pilot metrics are hit. Sales notes: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/c/NOTES-433

Anya (CSM): Thanks Devon. Please add PO and legal/infra contacts here. Also confirm preferred support cadence for onboarding.

Devon (Sales): PO: PO-99321. Legal: emily+contracts@novushealth.com. Infra lead: Raj (same). Cadence: weekly for first 4 weeks, then biweekly. They also want audit logs sent to Splunk.

Lydia (Solutions): From solutions side: recommended model variant = small-med quantized for latency. Need inventory of data connectors (S3, internal API) and whether PII will be stored in Redwood or proxied. Suggest a 2-week enablement sprint: week1 infra/provisioning + SSO, week2 testing + runbook validation. I'll own runbook + eval prompt set.

Sam (Support Eng): Creating ENG ticket for SSO + network: ENG-5421. We need SAML metadata + ACS URL from Raj and their SP metadata for our IdP. Also confirm cert rotation/pinning requirements. ETA for SSO prototype env: 5 business days. For VPC peering need VPC CIDRs and cloud team contact.

Devon (Sales): Raj confirmed SAML metadata coming and cert rotation every 90 days. They also requested 7-year audit log retention for compliance.

Sam (Support Eng): Got it — ENG-5421 open. I'll start prepping the prototype.

Oncall Bot: Ticket ENG-5421 created by Sam — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-5421 :white_check_mark:

Anya (CSM): Renewal risk assessment? Any commercial pressure or unusual clauses we should track? I'll also capture training attendees and proposed champions during kickoff.

Devon (Sales): Renewal risk: medium. Exec sponsor (CFO) supportive; technical champion unclear. Raj is infra lead but data team hasn't committed to adoption yet. Pilot budget only; if usage lags expansion is unlikely. No unique discounts.

Lydia (Solutions): Proposed success metrics for pilot: 1) pilot volume >= 20k tokens/day; 2) median latency < 200ms for typical 1k-token requests; 3) validation of three internal playbooks (SSO, backup restore, incident runbook). Hitting these should trigger Dedicated readiness review.

Anya (CSM): Action items:
- Anya: build 4-week onboarding plan + weekly agendas, share by 2024-04-26.
- Sam: own ENG-5421, gather SAML metadata + VPC CIDRs (ETA 5bd).
- Lydia: draft runbook + eval prompt set, share by 2024-04-24.
- Devon: intro email to Raj + legal to loop Anya in (ASAP).

Sam (Support Eng): Snippet to paste to Raj for SP metadata request:

```
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://redwood-idp.example">
  <!-- sample metadata -->
</EntityDescriptor>
```

Please send real XML.

Devon (Sales): Sending intro now to Raj, Emily, and copying Anya + Lydia.

Anya (CSM): Scheduling kickoff for 2024-04-29. I'll run a short post-kickoff feedback survey to capture enablement gaps.

Lydia (Solutions): I'll include a feedback rubric in the runbook (provisioning clarity, latency confidence, docs usefulness).

Devon (Sales): CISO asked for a short security questionnaire; I'll upload and ping when ready.

Anya (CSM): If anything gets blocked, tag me or escalate to #eng-oncall. :thumbsup:
